TJ Park Research 
 Fields of Research

2014 ~ 2015 
 
 
 
 1 Publishing University Textbooks : TJ Park's entrepreneural spirit and leadership 
 - We aim to spread and infuse TJ Park's entrepreneural spirit and leadership to college students 
 and young business leaders, so that they can be equipped with creativity, challenging spirit 
 and social contribution. 
 - We aim to shed light on and systematize TJ Park's entrepreneural spirit and leadership which 
 helped foster POSCO into the world's No. 1 steel company, so that they can develop into 
 a business theory. 
 - In an effort to spread it in a systematic way we aim to develop textbooks and open 
 courses related to TJ Park's entrepreneural spirit and leadership in college. 
 
 
 2 Development of textbooks on TJ Park's creative leadership for the youth with leadership 
 potential. 
 The systemic teaching and imparting of TJ Park's creative spirit, challenging spirit, and leadership to adolescents--who are the hope of the future society--is designed to contribute to building the appropriate purpose of life. 
 
 
 3 Spreading of the trust between Park Chung-hee and TJ Park and their success model to 
 foreign countries 
 We aim to select capable scholars out of POSCO TJ Foundation's Asian scholarship students who studied in Korea, in order to help spread TJ Park's philosophy and success model to other countries like Vietnam through projects. 
 
 
 4 Creation and teaching of texts to inherit the ideals of POSTECH foundation 
 Those who had participated in the foundation of POSTECH in 1986 retired and the staff have been replaced. So there is worry that the ideals propounded when POSTECH was created have been waning. For the sustainable development of POSTECH it is necessary to systematize and educate TJ Park's philosophy and some specific examples of resolving difficulties in the run-up to POSTECH's foundation.
